kickOffPrompt: Run the weather-forecast skill for the location given in the text item "location" of the session context. You are running non-interactively and nobody can answer questions: when something is unclear, make the most reasonable assumption and continue. Return the forecast, in the format the skill defines, as your final answer.

value.description: tomorrow's forecast for the location, or the region-not-exists notice followed by tomorrow's forecast for Tallinn

tool.name: weather_forecast
tool.description: Gives tomorrow's weather forecast for a city or country, from current web sources. Worth calling when tomorrow's weather somewhere matters for a plan or an answer; not for today's conditions, long-range forecasts or climate statistics. When the location is not a real city or country, it says so and forecasts Tallinn instead.

value.description: the city or country, e.g. Tartu
